item.title: Southampton County Public Schools closed on Monday
item.description: SCPS will close all buildings and offices Monday, Jan. 26, due to weather-related safety concerns, while officials monitor conditions for possible schedule changes.

item.title: Southampton County sheriff's office urges drivers to avoid icy, uncleared secondary roads
item.description: SCSO urges drivers to stay off icy, uncleared secondary roads; shares county updates including multiple crashes and reports of downed trees and utility lines.

item.title: FCPS to set community town hall meeting
item.description: Franklin City Public Schools chief plans February town hall open to all community members, with details to be unveiled at the Feb. 5 School Board session.

item.title: Charity earns two titles, victory at Daytona
item.description: Southampton County teen Sherod Charity captures WKA 100cc TAG senior and Grassroots Karting League LO206 lite titles, plus a Daytona Kartweek victory to open 2026.

item.title: COLUMN: Why do we double-down?
item.description: Dr. Qualls reflects on why some believers grow more rigid as knowledge decreases and argues that Christian faith is meant to be humble.

item.title: Gwendolyn Harriet Drewry Best
item.description: Gwendolyn Harriet Drewry Best, 91, passed away at home on Jan. 25, 2026.

item.title: SCPS closed Wednesday, Jan. 28
item.description: Southampton County Public Schools will close Wednesday, Jan. 28, and it will be a virtual learning day; free meals will be available at Southampton High, and a phone line will be open for questions.

item.title: Council votes to update floodplain regulations

item.title: 4th Red and Black Valentine’s Gala set
item.description: The fourth annual Red and Black Valentine's Gala, hosted by Theresa Hatch’s H&H Catering, will be held on Valentine’s Day (Saturday, Feb. 14,) at the Regional Workforce Development Center in Franklin. A gala news release noted that the doors will open at 5 p.m., and the event will run from 6 p.m. to midnight. This year’s event will be a repeat of last year, with the 360 photo booth and a photographer who will provide guests the opportunity to take and purchase a 5-by-7-inch photo of themselves.

item.title: Hugh Byrd Jr.
item.description: Hugh Byrd Jr., age 44, of Branchville, departed this earthly life on Sunday, Jan. 25, 2026 in Southside Regional Medical Center in Petersburg, Virginia.
